h1.en: Moving to Kentucky in 2026? Here Is How to Get Health Insurance
h1.es: Mudandose a Kentucky en 2026? Asi Consigue Seguro Medico

subhero.en: You have 60 days from your Kentucky move date to enroll in a new plan through kynect, Kentucky's state Marketplace. Kentucky expanded Medicaid, so if your income is under 138% FPL you may qualify for free coverage with no enrollment deadline.
subhero.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de mudanza a Kentucky para inscribirse en un nuevo plan a traves de kynect, el Mercado estatal de Kentucky. Kentucky expandio Medicaid, por lo que si su ingreso esta bajo el 138% FPL puede calificar para cobertura gratuita sin fecha limite.

heading.en: You have 60 days from your Kentucky move date to enroll
heading.es: Tiene 60 dias desde la fecha de mudanza a Kentucky para inscribirse

body.en: Your 60-day Special Enrollment Period runs from the day you establish Kentucky residency, for example June 13 through August 12 if you moved on June 13, 2026. Miss that window and you must wait until ACA Open Enrollment in November 2026 (for 2027 coverage) unless another qualifying life event occurs. Kentucky Medicaid has no deadline and accepts applications year-round if your income qualifies at or below 138% FPL.
body.es: Su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias corre desde el dia que establece residencia en Kentucky, por ejemplo del 13 de junio al 12 de agosto si se mudo el 13 de junio de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, debe esperar hasta la Inscripcion Abierta del ACA en noviembre de 2026 a menos que ocurra otro evento calificador de vida. Medicaid de Kentucky no tiene fecha limite si su ingreso califica al 138% FPL o menos.

quickAnswer.en: Moving to Kentucky triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP) starting from your move date. Kentucky runs its own state Marketplace called kynect at kynect.ky.gov, separate from the federal healthcare.gov. Kentucky is a full Medicaid expansion state: adults 19 to 64 with income at or below 138% FPL ($22,025 single, $45,540 family of 4 in 2026) qualify for Kentucky Medicaid year-round at no cost. Children under 19 can enroll year-round in Kentucky CHIP at incomes up to 218% FPL. If your income is between 100% and 400% FPL ($15,960 to $63,840 single in 2026), kynect Marketplace plans with premium tax credits are typically $10 to $300 per month after subsidies. You must have had prior coverage for at least one day in the 60 days before your move to qualify for the move SEP on kynect.
quickAnswer.es: Mudarse a Kentucky activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 60 dias desde la fecha de mudanza. Kentucky opera su propio Mercado estatal llamado kynect en kynect.ky.gov, separado del healthcare.gov federal. Kentucky es un estado con expansion completa de Medicaid: adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos en o bajo el 138% FPL ($22,025 soltero, $45,540 familia de 4 en 2026) califican para Medicaid de Kentucky sin fecha limite y sin costo. Ninos menores de 19 pueden inscribirse durante todo el ano en CHIP de Kentucky con ingresos hasta el 218% FPL. Si su ingreso es entre el 100% y el 400% FPL ($15,960 a $63,840 soltero en 2026), los planes del Mercado kynect con creditos fiscales de prima tipicamente cuestan $10 a $300 al mes.

introParagraphs.en: Moving to Kentucky creates an immediate health coverage decision, but the state's insurance landscape is notably more generous than many other states. Kentucky expanded Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act in January 2014 and has maintained full expansion continuously. As of 2026, Kentucky Medicaid covers adults aged 19 to 64 at incomes up to 138% of the Federal Poverty Level ($22,025 single, $45,540 for a family of 4 per 2026 HHS ASPE guidelines) with no coverage gap. If you move from a non-expansion state like Florida, Georgia, or Texas, you may gain Medicaid eligibility in Kentucky that you never had before. Your prior-state Medicaid terminates the day you establish Kentucky residency, but Kentucky's Cabinet for Health and Family Services (CHFS) accepts new applications year-round through kynect.ky.gov or benefind.ky.gov. Kentucky also operates kynect, a state-based Marketplace separate from the federal healthcare.gov, with three carriers available for 2026 plan year plans under a move SEP: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Ambetter by WellCare of Kentucky, and Passport Health Plan by Molina Healthcare (Bluegrass region). The 60-day Special Enrollment Period from your move date is your window to lock in subsidized kynect coverage if Medicaid does not apply. One critical prerequisite: healthcare.gov and kynect both require that you had minimum essential coverage for at least one day in the 60 days before your move date to qualify for the move SEP. Someone who was uninsured in their prior state does not qualify for the move SEP and must wait for the next ACA Open Enrollment Period beginning November 1, 2026.
introParagraphs.es: Mudarse a Kentucky crea una decision inmediata de cobertura medica, pero el panorama de seguros del estado es notablemente mas generoso que el de muchos otros estados. Kentucky expandio Medicaid bajo la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible en enero de 2014 y ha mantenido la expansion completa de manera continua. En 2026, Medicaid de Kentucky cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos hasta el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($22,025 soltero, $45,540 para una familia de 4) sin brecha de cobertura. Si se muda desde un estado sin expansion como Florida, Georgia o Texas, puede obtener elegibilidad para Medicaid en Kentucky que nunca tuvo antes. Su Medicaid del estado anterior termina el dia que establece residencia en Kentucky, pero el Gabinete de Servicios de Salud y Familia de Kentucky acepta nuevas solicitudes durante todo el ano a traves de kynect.ky.gov o benefind.ky.gov. Kentucky tambien opera kynect, un Mercado estatal separado del healthcare.gov federal, con tres portadores disponibles para 2026: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Ambetter by WellCare de Kentucky, y Passport Health Plan de Molina Healthcare (region Bluegrass). El SEP de 60 dias desde la fecha de mudanza es su ventana para asegurar cobertura subsidiada de kynect si Medicaid no aplica.

introParagraphs.en: Kentucky's Medicaid program underwent regulatory changes in 2026 under House Bill 2, signed in April 2026. Expansion adults (those who qualified under the 138% FPL expansion, not historically categorically eligible groups) now face small copays: $5 per medical service and $1 per prescription drug, capped at 5% of family income annually. Community engagement requirements of 80 hours per month are scheduled to begin tracking in December 2026 with enforcement starting January 2027, with exemptions for pregnant individuals, medically frail individuals, caregivers of dependents, full-time students, and those with serious mental illness or substance use disorder. Even with these changes, Kentucky Medicaid remains far cheaper than kynect Marketplace plans or COBRA for low-income new residents. For income-qualifying new arrivals, applying for Kentucky Medicaid through kynect.ky.gov immediately upon establishing residency is the fastest and most affordable path. For those whose income falls between 138% FPL and 400% FPL, kynect's Silver plans with premium tax credits frequently cost $10 to $150 per month, making them substantially cheaper than maintaining COBRA from your prior employer. The 2026 ACA subsidy cliff returned on January 1, 2026, when enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act expired: income above 400% FPL ($63,840 single) receives no premium tax credit on kynect. Check Medicaid income limits to see the full 2026 threshold by household size.
introParagraphs.es: El programa Medicaid de Kentucky paso por cambios regulatorios en 2026 bajo el Proyecto de Ley 2 del Congreso Estatal (HB 2), firmado en abril de 2026. Los adultos de la expansion ahora enfrentan pequenos copagos: $5 por servicio medico y $1 por medicamento recetado, con limite del 5% del ingreso familiar anual. Los requisitos de participacion comunitaria de 80 horas al mes estan programados para comenzar en diciembre de 2026 con aplicacion en enero de 2027, con exenciones para personas embarazadas, personas medicamente fragiles, cuidadores de dependientes, estudiantes de tiempo completo, y personas con enfermedades mentales graves o trastornos por uso de sustancias. Incluso con estos cambios, Medicaid de Kentucky sigue siendo mucho mas barato que los planes kynect o COBRA para nuevos residentes de bajos ingresos. Para los que llegan con ingresos que califican, solicitar Medicaid de Kentucky a traves de kynect.ky.gov de inmediato al establecer residencia es el camino mas rapido y asequible. El precipicio del subsidio ACA 2026 regreso el 1 de enero de 2026 cuando expiraron los creditos fiscales mejorados: ingresos por encima del 400% FPL ($63,840 soltero) no reciben credito fiscal de prima en kynect.

name.en: Establish your Kentucky move date and document it
name.es: Establezca su fecha de mudanza a Kentucky y documentela

text.en: Your 60-day SEP clock starts the day you establish Kentucky residency. Collect documentation immediately: a signed lease or mortgage statement at your new Kentucky address, a utility bill, a bank statement showing your Kentucky address, or a Kentucky driver's license application receipt. kynect.ky.gov requires at least one of these to verify the qualifying life event. Missing or delayed documentation is the top reason move SEP applications get flagged or denied.
text.es: El reloj del SEP de 60 dias comienza el dia que establece residencia en Kentucky. Reuna documentacion de inmediato: contrato de arrendamiento firmado o estado hipotecario con su nueva direccion de Kentucky, factura de servicios publicos, estado bancario con direccion de Kentucky, o recibo de solicitud de licencia de conducir de Kentucky. kynect.ky.gov requerira al menos uno de estos documentos para verificar el evento calificador de vida.

name.es: Verifique primero su elegibilidad para Medicaid de Kentucky

text.en: Log in to kynect.ky.gov or benefind.ky.gov and apply for Kentucky Medicaid if your projected annual income is at or below 138% FPL ($22,025 single or $45,540 for a family of 4 in 2026). Kentucky is a full Medicaid expansion state with no coverage gap for adults aged 19 to 64. Kentucky Medicaid has no enrollment deadline, so apply as soon as you establish residency. If you have children under age 19, check eligibility for Kentucky CHIP at incomes up to 218% FPL ($47,520 for a family of 4 in 2026), also year-round.
text.es: Inicie sesion en kynect.ky.gov o benefind.ky.gov y solicite Medicaid de Kentucky si su ingreso anual proyectado es en o bajo el 138% FPL ($22,025 soltero o $45,540 para una familia de 4 en 2026). Kentucky es un estado con expansion completa de Medicaid sin brecha de cobertura para adultos de 19 a 64 anos. Medicaid de Kentucky no tiene fecha limite de inscripcion, por lo que solicite tan pronto como establezca residencia. Si tiene ninos menores de 19 anos, verifique elegibilidad para CHIP de Kentucky con ingresos hasta el 218% FPL.

name.en: Calculate your projected Kentucky income for kynect subsidy eligibility
name.es: Calcule su ingreso proyectado en Kentucky para elegibilidad de subsidios kynect

text.en: kynect Marketplace premium tax credits use your projected annual Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) from your Kentucky move date through December 31, 2026. For 2026, the ACA subsidy range is 100% to 400% FPL ($15,960 to $63,840 for a single adult per 2026 HHS ASPE Poverty Guidelines). Income above 400% FPL does not qualify for premium tax credits in 2026 because the enhanced ACA subsidies from the American Rescue Plan Act expired January 1, 2026. Use your best forward-looking income estimate, not your prior-state income history.
text.es: Los creditos fiscales de prima del Mercado kynect usan su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) proyectado anual desde la fecha de mudanza a Kentucky hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2026. Para 2026, el rango de subsidios del ACA es del 100% al 400% FPL ($15,960 a $63,840 para un adulto soltero). Ingresos por encima del 400% FPL no califican para creditos fiscales de prima en 2026 porque los subsidios mejorados del ACA de la Ley del Plan de Rescate Americano expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026.

name.en: Enroll in a kynect Marketplace plan using the move SEP
name.es: Inscribase en un plan del Mercado kynect usando el SEP de mudanza

text.en: Log in to kynect.ky.gov and select 'I moved to a new coverage area' as your qualifying life event. Enter your new Kentucky ZIP code to see plans from Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Ambetter by WellCare of Kentucky (108 of 120 Kentucky counties), and Passport Health Plan by Molina Healthcare (Bluegrass region). Compare Silver, Gold, and Bronze plans by monthly premium after tax credit, deductible, and the in-network provider directory for your Kentucky county. Silver plans also qualify for cost-sharing reduction (CSR) subsidies if your income is 100% to 250% FPL. Coverage typically starts the first day of the month after enrollment if you apply by the 15th. Call a free kynector enrollment assistant at 1-855-4kynect (1-855-459-6328) if you need help.
text.es: Inicie sesion en kynect.ky.gov y seleccione 'Me mude a una nueva area de cobertura' como su evento calificador de vida. Ingrese su nuevo codigo postal de Kentucky para ver planes de Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Ambetter by WellCare de Kentucky (108 de 120 condados de Kentucky), y Passport Health Plan de Molina Healthcare (region Bluegrass). Compare planes Silver, Gold y Bronze por prima mensual despues del credito fiscal, deducible y directorio de proveedores en red para su condado de Kentucky. Los planes Silver tambien califican para subsidios de reduccion de costo compartido (CSR) si su ingreso es del 100% al 250% FPL. La cobertura tipicamente comienza el primer dia del mes siguiente si solicita antes del dia 15.

name.en: If you have employer coverage, verify your Kentucky address is in-network
name.es: Si tiene cobertura del empleador, verifique que su direccion en Kentucky esta en la red

text.en: Call HR or check the plan's provider directory for your new Kentucky ZIP code. PPO plans frequently have national networks that include Kentucky, but HMO and EPO plans may have no in-network providers in your Kentucky county. If the employer plan does not cover your new area, request a Special Enrollment Period from HR under HIPAA Section 9831: a permanent move that creates a change in plan network availability is a qualifying event, and most employers allow a 30-day window to switch plans.
text.es: Llame a Recursos Humanos o revise el directorio de proveedores del plan para su nuevo codigo postal de Kentucky. Los planes PPO frecuentemente tienen redes nacionales que incluyen Kentucky, pero los planes HMO y EPO pueden no tener proveedores en red en su condado de Kentucky. Si el plan del empleador no cubre su nueva area, solicite un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial a Recursos Humanos bajo la Seccion 9831 de HIPAA: una mudanza permanente que cambia la disponibilidad de red del plan es un evento calificador.

name.en: Cancel your prior state's coverage and preserve termination documentation
name.es: Cancele la cobertura de su estado anterior y conserve la documentacion de terminacion

text.en: Log in to your old state's marketplace or healthcare.gov and terminate your prior plan effective your Kentucky move date. If you had Medicaid in your prior state, notify that state's Medicaid agency in writing. Keep the written termination notice as documentation: kynect requires proof of prior minimum essential coverage for at least one day in the 60 days before your move date to qualify for the move SEP. Maintaining simultaneous Marketplace coverage in two states creates subsidy reconciliation problems on your 1095-A when you file your 2026 federal taxes.
text.es: Inicie sesion en el mercado de su estado anterior o healthcare.gov y cancele su plan anterior con vigencia en la fecha de mudanza a Kentucky. Si tenia Medicaid en su estado anterior, notifique por escrito a la agencia de Medicaid de ese estado. Conserve el aviso de terminacion escrito como documentacion: kynect requiere prueba de cobertura minima esencial durante al menos un dia en los 60 dias antes de la fecha de mudanza. Mantener cobertura simultanea del Mercado en dos estados crea problemas de reconciliacion de subsidios en el formulario 1095-A.

name.en: Submit proof of prior coverage to complete the kynect SEP application
name.es: Envie prueba de cobertura anterior para completar la solicitud SEP de kynect

text.en: kynect requires proof of prior minimum essential coverage to trigger the move SEP. Submit a HIPAA Certificate of Creditable Coverage from your prior insurer, your old COBRA notice, a prior-state Medicaid termination letter, or a prior Marketplace plan termination notice. Someone who was uninsured before moving to Kentucky does not qualify for the move SEP and must wait for the next ACA Open Enrollment Period (November 1, 2026 through January 15, 2027 for 2027 coverage) unless another qualifying life event occurs.
text.es: kynect requiere prueba de cobertura minima esencial anterior para activar el SEP de mudanza. Envie un Certificado de Cobertura Acreditable de HIPAA de su aseguradora anterior, su aviso de COBRA, una carta de terminacion de Medicaid del estado anterior, o un aviso de terminacion de plan del Mercado anterior. Alguien que no tenia seguro antes de mudarse a Kentucky no califica para el SEP de mudanza y debe esperar hasta el proximo Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta del ACA (1 de noviembre de 2026 al 15 de enero de 2027).

intro.en: The most costly mistakes people make when moving to Kentucky and switching health coverage:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que cometen las personas al mudarse a Kentucky y cambiar su cobertura medica:

items.en: Missing the 60-day SEP window. Without the move SEP, you cannot enroll in a kynect plan until November 1, 2026 (for 2027 coverage), leaving months without insurance if you also fail to qualify for Kentucky Medicaid.
items.es: Perder la ventana del SEP de 60 dias. Sin el SEP de mudanza, no puede inscribirse en un plan kynect hasta el 1 de noviembre de 2026 (para cobertura 2027), dejandolo meses sin seguro si tampoco califica para Medicaid de Kentucky.

items.en: Not having prior coverage before the move. kynect's move SEP requires that you held minimum essential coverage for at least one day in the 60 days before your Kentucky arrival. Arriving uninsured disqualifies you from the move SEP entirely.
items.es: No tener cobertura anterior antes de la mudanza. El SEP de mudanza de kynect requiere que tuvo cobertura minima esencial durante al menos un dia en los 60 dias antes de llegar a Kentucky. Llegar sin seguro le descalifica del SEP de mudanza por completo.

items.en: Enrolling on kynect.ky.gov before applying through healthcare.gov: Kentucky uses kynect, its own state-based Marketplace, NOT the federal healthcare.gov for Marketplace enrollment. Applying on healthcare.gov redirects Kentucky residents to kynect and can delay your coverage start date.
items.es: Inscribirse en healthcare.gov en lugar de kynect.ky.gov: Kentucky usa kynect, su propio Mercado estatal, NO el healthcare.gov federal para inscripciones del Mercado. Solicitar en healthcare.gov redirige a los residentes de Kentucky a kynect y puede retrasar la fecha de inicio de cobertura.

items.en: Defaulting to COBRA without comparing kynect plans. COBRA charges 102% of the full premium, often $500 to $2,000 per month. kynect Silver plans with premium tax credits typically cost $10 to $150 per month for someone earning $25,000 to $40,000 annually in 2026.
items.es: Aceptar COBRA sin comparar planes kynect. COBRA cobra el 102% de la prima completa, a menudo $500 a $2,000 al mes. Los planes Silver de kynect con creditos fiscales tipicamente cuestan $10 a $150 al mes para alguien que gana $25,000 a $40,000 anuales en 2026.

items.en: Forgetting to check Kentucky Medicaid first. Kentucky is a full Medicaid expansion state. New residents moving in from non-expansion states may qualify for free Kentucky Medicaid when they never qualified before. Check eligibility at kynect.ky.gov before shopping Marketplace plans.
items.es: Olvidar verificar primero Medicaid de Kentucky. Kentucky es un estado con expansion completa de Medicaid. Nuevos residentes de estados sin expansion pueden calificar para Medicaid gratuito de Kentucky cuando nunca calificaron antes. Verifique elegibilidad en kynect.ky.gov antes de comparar planes del Mercado.

items.en: Not checking network coverage in your specific Kentucky county before selecting a plan. Ambetter by WellCare covers 108 of 120 Kentucky counties; Passport Health Plan by Molina Healthcare operates primarily in the Bluegrass region. Your county determines which carriers are available, and carrier networks vary significantly in rural eastern and western Kentucky.
items.es: No verificar la cobertura de red en su condado especifico de Kentucky antes de seleccionar un plan. Ambetter by WellCare cubre 108 de 120 condados de Kentucky; Passport Health Plan de Molina Healthcare opera principalmente en la region Bluegrass. Su condado determina que portadores estan disponibles, y las redes de portadores varian significativamente en el este y oeste rural de Kentucky.

heading.en: kynect vs healthcare.gov: Which Portal Should You Use in Kentucky?
heading.es: kynect vs healthcare.gov: Cual Portal Debe Usar en Kentucky?

paragraphs.en: Kentucky operates kynect (kynect.ky.gov) as its own state-based Marketplace, separate from the federal healthcare.gov. New Kentucky residents must enroll through kynect, not the federal portal, for Marketplace plans. kynect is administered by the Kentucky Health Benefit Exchange (KHBE) within the Kentucky Cabinet for Health and Family Services. Three carriers participate in the 2026 kynect Marketplace for move SEP enrollees: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield (statewide), Ambetter by WellCare of Kentucky (108 of 120 counties), and Passport Health Plan by Molina Healthcare (Bluegrass region including Fayette and Jefferson counties). Enrolling on the wrong portal can delay your coverage start date, as healthcare.gov will detect your Kentucky ZIP code and route you to kynect. Log in directly at kynect.ky.gov to avoid this. kynect also handles Kentucky Medicaid and CHIP applications through the same portal, so a single application screens you for all three programs simultaneously.
paragraphs.es: Kentucky opera kynect (kynect.ky.gov) como su propio Mercado estatal, separado del healthcare.gov federal. Los nuevos residentes de Kentucky deben inscribirse a traves de kynect, no del portal federal, para planes del Mercado. kynect es administrado por el Kentucky Health Benefit Exchange (KHBE) dentro del Gabinete de Servicios de Salud y Familia de Kentucky. Tres portadores participan en el Mercado kynect 2026 para inscripciones bajo el SEP de mudanza: Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield (en todo el estado), Ambetter by WellCare de Kentucky (108 de 120 condados), y Passport Health Plan de Molina Healthcare (region Bluegrass incluyendo los condados de Fayette y Jefferson). Inscribirse en el portal equivocado puede retrasar la fecha de inicio de cobertura. Inicie sesion directamente en kynect.ky.gov para evitar esto. kynect tambien gestiona solicitudes de Medicaid y CHIP de Kentucky a traves del mismo portal.

paragraphs.en: Kentucky also offers free kynector enrollment assistants, available in all 120 counties, who can help complete a kynect or Medicaid application at no charge. Call 1-855-4kynect (1-855-459-6328) or use the kynect website to find an in-person kynector near you. kynectors are especially helpful for new residents navigating the system for the first time, selecting between carrier options in rural counties, and confirming whether Medicaid or a subsidized Marketplace plan is the right fit given projected 2026 income.
paragraphs.es: Kentucky tambien ofrece asistentes de inscripcion kynector gratuitos, disponibles en los 120 condados, que pueden ayudar a completar una solicitud de kynect o Medicaid sin cargo. Llame al 1-855-4kynect (1-855-459-6328) o use el sitio web de kynect para encontrar un kynector en persona cerca de usted. Los kynectors son especialmente utiles para nuevos residentes que navegan el sistema por primera vez, seleccionan entre opciones de portadores en condados rurales, y confirman si Medicaid o un plan subsidiado del Mercado es la opcion correcta.

heading.en: Kentucky Medicaid Eligibility for New Residents in 2026
heading.es: Elegibilidad de Medicaid de Kentucky para Nuevos Residentes en 2026

paragraphs.en: Kentucky Medicaid covers all adults aged 19 to 64 at incomes up to 138% of the Federal Poverty Level, with no categorical restrictions for non-disabled adults (unlike non-expansion states where coverage is limited to parents, pregnant women, and the aged/blind/disabled). For 2026, 138% FPL is $22,025 for a single person and $45,540 for a family of 4 per HHS ASPE 2026 Poverty Guidelines. New residents who establish Kentucky residency and submit a Medicaid application through kynect.ky.gov or benefind.ky.gov qualify without delay. Approval is typically same-day or within 2 to 5 business days for income-based expansion adults. Under Kentucky HB 2 enacted April 2026, expansion adults now pay small copays ($5 per service, $1 per prescription drug) capped at 5% of family income. Community engagement requirements of 80 hours per month are expected to begin tracking in December 2026 with enforcement starting January 2027, but exemptions are broad, covering pregnant individuals, medically frail individuals, caregivers of dependents under 18 or over 65, full-time students, and those with serious mental illness or substance use disorder. Even with copays, Kentucky Medicaid is far less expensive than any COBRA or Marketplace premium for an individual earning less than $22,025 per year.
paragraphs.es: Medicaid de Kentucky cubre a todos los adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos hasta el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, sin restricciones categoricas para adultos no discapacitados (a diferencia de los estados sin expansion donde la cobertura se limita a padres, mujeres embarazadas y personas de edad avanzada, ciegas o discapacitadas). Para 2026, el 138% FPL es $22,025 para una persona sola y $45,540 para una familia de 4. Los nuevos residentes que establecen residencia en Kentucky y presentan una solicitud de Medicaid a traves de kynect.ky.gov o benefind.ky.gov califican sin demora. La aprobacion es tipicamente el mismo dia o dentro de 2 a 5 dias habiles para adultos de la expansion basada en ingresos. Bajo el HB 2 de Kentucky de abril de 2026, los adultos de la expansion ahora pagan pequenos copagos ($5 por servicio, $1 por medicamento) con limite del 5% del ingreso familiar. Incluso con copagos, Medicaid de Kentucky es mucho menos costoso que cualquier prima de COBRA o del Mercado para un individuo que gana menos de $22,025 al ano.

paragraphs.en: Children under 19 in Kentucky who do not qualify for Medicaid can enroll year-round in Kentucky CHIP at household incomes up to 218% FPL ($47,520 for a family of 4 in 2026). Pregnant women in Kentucky qualify for Medicaid at incomes up to 195% FPL under the pregnancy-related Medicaid category, which covers prenatal care, delivery, and 12 months of postpartum coverage. Seniors age 65 and older with limited income and resources can also apply for full-benefit dual eligible coverage (Medicare plus Kentucky Medicaid) or a Medicare Savings Program that helps pay Part B premiums and cost-sharing. Apply through Kentucky CHFS at chfs.ky.gov or through the kynect portal. For complete 2026 income thresholds by household size, see Medicaid income limits.
paragraphs.es: Los ninos menores de 19 anos en Kentucky que no califican para Medicaid pueden inscribirse durante todo el ano en CHIP de Kentucky con ingresos del hogar hasta el 218% FPL ($47,520 para una familia de 4 en 2026). Las mujeres embarazadas en Kentucky califican para Medicaid con ingresos hasta el 195% FPL bajo la categoria de Medicaid relacionada con el embarazo, que cubre atencion prenatal, parto y 12 meses de cobertura posparto. Los adultos mayores de 65 anos con ingresos y recursos limitados tambien pueden solicitar cobertura dual elegible completa (Medicare mas Medicaid de Kentucky) o un Programa de Ahorros de Medicare. Solicite a traves de Kentucky CHFS en chfs.ky.gov o a traves del portal kynect.

heading.en: Documents Needed to Enroll in kynect After a Move
heading.es: Documentos Necesarios para Inscribirse en kynect Despues de una Mudanza

paragraphs.en: kynect requires specific documentation to trigger the move SEP and complete enrollment. Gather these documents before starting your application to avoid delays. Proof of Kentucky residency must be dated within 60 days of your move: a signed lease or mortgage agreement with your Kentucky address, a utility bill, a Kentucky driver's license application, a bank statement, or an employer letter confirming your Kentucky work location. For the SEP itself, proof of prior minimum essential coverage is required: submit a HIPAA Certificate of Creditable Coverage from your prior insurer, a prior Marketplace plan termination notice, a prior employer coverage termination letter, or a prior-state Medicaid termination letter. Social Security numbers are required for all household members applying. Income verification documents include recent pay stubs (last 2 to 4 weeks), an employer letter, an unemployment award letter, or your most recent federal tax return (Form 1040) for self-employed applicants. If adding dependents to a kynect plan, bring birth certificates for children and a marriage certificate for a spouse. Keep all documentation for at least three years: kynect may request it during subsidy reconciliation when your 1095-A is issued in January 2027.
paragraphs.es: kynect requiere documentacion especifica para activar el SEP de mudanza y completar la inscripcion. Reuna estos documentos antes de comenzar su solicitud para evitar retrasos. La prueba de residencia en Kentucky debe estar fechada dentro de los 60 dias de la mudanza: un contrato de arrendamiento firmado o acuerdo hipotecario con su direccion de Kentucky, una factura de servicios publicos, una solicitud de licencia de conducir de Kentucky, un estado bancario, o una carta del empleador confirmando su lugar de trabajo en Kentucky. Para el SEP, se requiere prueba de cobertura minima esencial anterior: envie un Certificado de Cobertura Acreditable de HIPAA de su aseguradora anterior, un aviso de terminacion de plan del Mercado anterior, una carta de terminacion de cobertura del empleador anterior, o una carta de terminacion de Medicaid del estado anterior. Los numeros de Seguro Social son requeridos para todos los miembros del hogar que solicitan. Guarde toda la documentacion por al menos tres anos.

en.caption: Kentucky Medicaid, CHIP, and kynect ACA subsidy income limits, 2026 (48 contiguous states + DC)
en.footnote: Kentucky Medicaid covers adults 19 to 64 at 138% FPL with no coverage gap (full expansion state). Kentucky CHIP income limit is approximately 218% FPL per CHFS 2026 guidelines. The ACA subsidy cliff returned January 1, 2026 when enhanced PTCs from ARPA expired; income above 400% FPL receives no premium tax credit on kynect. 218% FPL values derived from 2026 FPL base of $15,960 for household of 1 plus $5,680 per additional person (HHS ASPE 2026 Poverty Guidelines).

es.footnote: Medicaid de Kentucky cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos al 138% FPL sin brecha de cobertura (estado con expansion completa). El limite de ingresos del CHIP de Kentucky es aproximadamente el 218% FPL. El precipicio del subsidio ACA regreso el 1 de enero de 2026 cuando vencieron los PTCs mejorados de ARPA; ingresos por encima del 400% FPL no reciben credito fiscal de prima en kynect.

en: Proof of Kentucky residency dated within 60 days of move: signed lease or mortgage statement, utility bill, bank statement, or employer letter with new Kentucky address

Proof of prior minimum essential coverage (required for move SEP): HIPAA Certificate of Creditable Coverage, prior Marketplace termination notice, prior employer coverage termination letter, or prior-state Medicaid termination letter
Social Security numbers for everyone applying (required for kynect enrollment and Kentucky Medicaid/CHIP)
Move date documentation: moving company receipt, U-Haul contract, or lease commencement date confirming when Kentucky residency began
Proof of income: recent pay stubs (last 2 to 4 weeks), employer letter, unemployment award letter, or prior-year Form 1040 for self-employed applicants
Kentucky driver's license or state ID application receipt (if recently applied; confirms residency intent)
Birth certificates for dependent children (if applying for Kentucky CHIP or adding dependents to a kynect plan)
Marriage certificate (if adding a spouse to a kynect plan or claiming spouse as a dependent on a Medicaid application)
es: Prueba de residencia en Kentucky fechada dentro de 60 dias de la mudanza: contrato de arrendamiento firmado o estado hipotecario, factura de servicios publicos, estado bancario, o carta del empleador con nueva direccion de Kentucky

Prueba de cobertura minima esencial anterior (requerida para el SEP de mudanza): Certificado de Cobertura Acreditable de HIPAA, aviso de terminacion de Mercado anterior, carta de terminacion de cobertura del empleador anterior, o carta de terminacion de Medicaid del estado anterior
Numeros de Seguro Social para todos los que solicitan (requerido para inscripcion en kynect y Medicaid/CHIP de Kentucky)
Documentacion de fecha de mudanza: recibo de empresa de mudanza, contrato de U-Haul, o fecha de inicio del arrendamiento confirmando cuando comenzo la residencia en Kentucky
Prueba de ingresos: talones de pago recientes (ultimas 2 a 4 semanas), carta del empleador, carta de asignacion de desempleo, o Formulario 1040 del ano anterior para solicitantes por cuenta propia
Solicitud de licencia de conducir o identificacion estatal de Kentucky (si solicito recientemente; confirma intencion de residencia)
Actas de nacimiento de hijos dependientes (si solicita CHIP de Kentucky o agrega dependientes a un plan kynect)
Acta de matrimonio (si agrega un conyuge a un plan kynect o lo reclama como dependiente en una solicitud de Medicaid)

stateRules.rule: Kentucky expanded Medicaid under the ACA in January 2014 and has maintained full expansion. Adults 19 to 64 at incomes up to 138% FPL qualify for Kentucky Medicaid year-round with no coverage gap. Under HB 2 enacted April 2026, expansion adults pay small copays ($5/service, $1/Rx) capped at 5% of family income, and community engagement requirements of 80 hours per month begin tracking December 2026 with exemptions for caregivers, pregnant individuals, and medically frail individuals.

Kentucky operates kynect (kynect.ky.gov) as its own state-based Marketplace, separate from the federal healthcare.gov. New Kentucky residents must enroll through kynect for ACA Marketplace plans. kynect also handles Medicaid and CHIP applications. Free kynector enrollment assistants are available in all 120 Kentucky counties at 1-855-4kynect (1-855-459-6328).

Kentucky Mini-COBRA (KRS 304.18-110) requires insurers issuing group policies to small employers (fewer than 20 employees) to offer continuation coverage to employees and dependents for up to 18 months at 102% of the full premium. This mirrors federal COBRA for employees whose former employer is too small for federal COBRA to apply.

en: No prior coverage before the move: kynect requires minimum essential coverage for at least one day in the 60 days before the move date to qualify for the move SEP. Applicants who were uninsured in their prior state do not qualify.
Missing the 60-day SEP window: submitting a kynect Marketplace application after day 60 from the move date. The SEP is strict; kynect does not allow retroactive enrollment beyond this window.

Insufficient proof of residency: providing documentation that is not dated within 60 days of the move, or submitting documents that do not clearly show a Kentucky address (such as a national lease with no unit address).

Incorrect portal: applying through healthcare.gov instead of kynect.ky.gov. Kentucky is a state-based Marketplace; federal applications for Kentucky residents are incomplete until transferred to kynect, causing delays.

Reporting prior-state income instead of projected Kentucky income: ACA subsidy eligibility uses projected forward-looking MAGI. Submitting prior-year income from a higher-income period inflates the calculated subsidy incorrectly and may trigger reconciliation problems on Form 1095-A.
es: Sin cobertura previa antes de la mudanza: kynect requiere cobertura minima esencial durante al menos un dia en los 60 dias antes de la fecha de mudanza para calificar para el SEP de mudanza. Los solicitantes que no tenian seguro en su estado anterior no califican.

Perder la ventana del SEP de 60 dias: presentar una solicitud del Mercado kynect despues del dia 60 desde la fecha de mudanza. El SEP es estricto; kynect no permite inscripcion retroactiva mas alla de esta ventana.
Prueba de residencia insuficiente: proporcionar documentacion que no esta fechada dentro de los 60 dias de la mudanza, o presentar documentos que no muestran claramente una direccion de Kentucky.

Portal incorrecto: solicitar a traves de healthcare.gov en lugar de kynect.ky.gov. Kentucky es un Mercado estatal; las solicitudes federales para residentes de Kentucky estan incompletas hasta que se transfieren a kynect, causando retrasos.

Reportar ingresos del estado anterior en lugar del ingreso proyectado de Kentucky: la elegibilidad del subsidio del ACA usa el MAGI proyectado hacia adelante. Presentar ingresos del ano anterior de un periodo de mayor ingreso calcula incorrectamente el subsidio.

en.question: What is the SEP window for moving to Kentucky?
en.answer: Moving to Kentucky triggers a 60-day Special Enrollment Period starting from the day you establish Kentucky residency. For example, if you move on July 1, 2026, your SEP window runs July 1 through August 30, 2026. You must apply through kynect.ky.gov (Kentucky's state Marketplace) before that deadline to enroll in a subsidized plan. Kentucky Medicaid has no SEP deadline and accepts applications year-round for adults 19 to 64 with income at or below 138% FPL ($22,025 single in 2026).

en.question: Do I need prior coverage to qualify for the Kentucky move SEP?
en.answer: Yes. kynect requires that you had minimum essential coverage for at least one day in the 60 days before your Kentucky move date to qualify for the move Special Enrollment Period. Acceptable proof includes a HIPAA Certificate of Creditable Coverage, a prior Marketplace plan termination notice, an employer coverage termination letter, or a prior-state Medicaid termination letter. Someone who was uninsured before moving to Kentucky does not qualify for the move SEP and must wait for the next ACA Open Enrollment Period (November 1, 2026 through January 15, 2027 for 2027 coverage).

en.question: Does Kentucky Medicaid transfer from another state?
en.answer: No. Medicaid is a state-administered program. Your prior-state Medicaid terminates the day you establish Kentucky residency. However, if your income qualifies (138% FPL or below for adults 19 to 64 in 2026), you can apply for Kentucky Medicaid immediately through kynect.ky.gov or benefind.ky.gov with no waiting period. Kentucky is a full Medicaid expansion state, so you may gain eligibility you did not have in your prior state if it was a non-expansion state such as Florida, Georgia, or Texas.

en.question: How do I enroll in health insurance through kynect after moving to Kentucky?
en.answer: Log in to kynect.ky.gov and select 'I moved to a new coverage area' as your qualifying life event. Enter your new Kentucky ZIP code to see available plans with premium tax credits applied. Kentucky's 2026 kynect carriers are Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield (statewide), Ambetter by WellCare (108 of 120 counties), and Passport Health Plan by Molina Healthcare (Bluegrass region). Compare Silver plans for cost-sharing reductions if your income is 100% to 250% FPL. Coverage starts the first of the month after you enroll if you apply by the 15th. Free kynector enrollment assistants are available in all 120 counties at 1-855-459-6328.

en.question: What if I miss the 60-day SEP window after moving to Kentucky?
en.answer: Missing the 60-day move SEP means you cannot enroll in a subsidized kynect Marketplace plan until the next ACA Open Enrollment Period (November 1, 2026 through January 15, 2027 for 2027 coverage) unless another qualifying life event occurs. Kentucky Medicaid is not affected by the 60-day SEP deadline: if your income qualifies (138% FPL or below), you can apply year-round through kynect.ky.gov. Children may also apply for Kentucky CHIP year-round at incomes up to 218% FPL.

en.question: Is Kentucky Medicaid different from what I had in my old state?
en.answer: Kentucky Medicaid is a full Medicaid expansion program covering adults 19 to 64 at incomes up to 138% FPL ($22,025 single, $45,540 family of 4 in 2026) with comprehensive benefits and no coverage gap. Under Kentucky HB 2 enacted April 2026, expansion adults now pay small copays ($5 per service, $1 per prescription drug) capped at 5% of household income annually. Community engagement requirements of 80 hours per month are expected to begin tracking in December 2026. If you moved from a non-expansion state, Kentucky Medicaid may cover you when your prior state's program did not.

en.question: Do I qualify for Kentucky Medicaid if I just moved from another state?
en.answer: Yes, if you establish Kentucky residency and your projected annual household income is at or below 138% FPL ($22,025 single, $45,540 family of 4 in 2026). Apply at kynect.ky.gov or benefind.ky.gov. Approval is typically same-day or within 2 to 5 business days for expansion adults. Moving from a non-expansion state like Georgia or Florida means you may qualify for Kentucky Medicaid for the first time under the expansion. Your prior-state Medicaid terminates when you establish Kentucky residency; apply immediately to avoid any coverage gap.

en.question: What documents do I need for the kynect move SEP application?
en.answer: kynect requires three categories of documents for a move SEP: (1) proof of Kentucky residency dated within 60 days of your move (signed lease, utility bill, bank statement, or employer letter); (2) proof of prior minimum essential coverage (HIPAA creditable coverage certificate, prior Marketplace or employer termination notice, or prior-state Medicaid termination letter); and (3) income verification (recent pay stubs, employer letter, unemployment award letter, or prior-year Form 1040). Social Security numbers for all applying household members are required. Gather all documents before starting the kynect application to prevent review delays.

es.question: Cual es la ventana del SEP para mudarse a Kentucky?
es.answer: Mudarse a Kentucky activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 60 dias a partir del dia que establece residencia en Kentucky. Por ejemplo, si se muda el 1 de julio de 2026, su ventana del SEP corre del 1 de julio al 30 de agosto de 2026. Debe solicitar a traves de kynect.ky.gov (el Mercado estatal de Kentucky) antes de esa fecha limite. Medicaid de Kentucky no tiene fecha limite del SEP y acepta solicitudes todo el ano para adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos en o bajo el 138% FPL ($22,025 soltero en 2026).

es.question: Necesito cobertura previa para calificar para el SEP de mudanza de Kentucky?
es.answer: Si. kynect requiere que tuvo cobertura minima esencial durante al menos un dia en los 60 dias antes de la fecha de mudanza a Kentucky para calificar para el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de mudanza. La prueba aceptable incluye un Certificado de Cobertura Acreditable de HIPAA, un aviso de terminacion de plan del Mercado anterior, una carta de terminacion de cobertura del empleador, o una carta de terminacion de Medicaid del estado anterior. Alguien que no tenia seguro antes de mudarse a Kentucky no califica para el SEP de mudanza y debe esperar hasta el proximo Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta del ACA.

es.question: Medicaid de Kentucky se transfiere desde otro estado?
es.answer: No. Medicaid es un programa administrado por cada estado. Su Medicaid del estado anterior termina el dia que establece residencia en Kentucky. Sin embargo, si su ingreso califica (138% FPL o menos para adultos de 19 a 64 en 2026), puede solicitar Medicaid de Kentucky de inmediato a traves de kynect.ky.gov o benefind.ky.gov sin periodo de espera. Kentucky es un estado con expansion completa de Medicaid, por lo que puede obtener elegibilidad que no tenia en su estado anterior si era un estado sin expansion como Florida, Georgia o Texas.

es.question: Como me inscribo en seguro medico a traves de kynect despues de mudarme a Kentucky?
es.answer: Inicie sesion en kynect.ky.gov y seleccione 'Me mude a una nueva area de cobertura' como su evento calificador de vida. Ingrese su nuevo codigo postal de Kentucky para ver los planes disponibles con creditos fiscales de prima aplicados. Los portadores de kynect 2026 en Kentucky son Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield (en todo el estado), Ambetter by WellCare (108 de 120 condados), y Passport Health Plan de Molina Healthcare (region Bluegrass). Compare planes Silver para reducciones de costos compartidos si su ingreso es del 100% al 250% FPL. La cobertura comienza el primero del mes siguiente si solicita antes del dia 15. Asistentes kynector gratuitos estan disponibles en los 120 condados al 1-855-459-6328.

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo la ventana del SEP de 60 dias despues de mudarme a Kentucky?
es.answer: Perder el SEP de mudanza de 60 dias significa que no puede inscribirse en un plan subsidiado del Mercado kynect hasta el proximo Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta del ACA (1 de noviembre de 2026 al 15 de enero de 2027 para cobertura 2027), a menos que ocurra otro evento calificador de vida. Medicaid de Kentucky no se ve afectado por la fecha limite del SEP de 60 dias: si su ingreso califica (138% FPL o menos), puede solicitar todo el ano a traves de kynect.ky.gov. Los ninos tambien pueden solicitar CHIP de Kentucky todo el ano con ingresos hasta el 218% FPL.

es.question: Medicaid de Kentucky es diferente de lo que tenia en mi estado anterior?
es.answer: Medicaid de Kentucky es un programa de expansion completa que cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos hasta el 138% FPL ($22,025 soltero, $45,540 familia de 4 en 2026) con beneficios integrales y sin brecha de cobertura. Bajo el HB 2 de Kentucky de abril de 2026, los adultos de la expansion ahora pagan pequenos copagos ($5 por servicio, $1 por medicamento recetado) con limite del 5% del ingreso del hogar anualmente. Los requisitos de participacion comunitaria de 80 horas al mes deben comenzar en diciembre de 2026. Si se mudo desde un estado sin expansion, Medicaid de Kentucky puede cubrirle cuando el programa de su estado anterior no lo hacia.

es.question: Califico para Medicaid de Kentucky si acabo de mudarme de otro estado?
es.answer: Si, si establece residencia en Kentucky y su ingreso anual proyectado del hogar es en o bajo el 138% FPL ($22,025 soltero, $45,540 familia de 4 en 2026). Solicite en kynect.ky.gov o benefind.ky.gov. La aprobacion tipicamente es el mismo dia o dentro de 2 a 5 dias habiles. Mudarse desde un estado sin expansion como Georgia o Florida significa que puede calificar para Medicaid de Kentucky por primera vez bajo la expansion. Su Medicaid del estado anterior termina cuando establece residencia en Kentucky; solicite de inmediato para evitar cualquier brecha de cobertura.

es.question: Que documentos necesito para la solicitud del SEP de mudanza de kynect?
es.answer: kynect requiere tres categorias de documentos para un SEP de mudanza: (1) prueba de residencia en Kentucky fechada dentro de los 60 dias de la mudanza (contrato de arrendamiento firmado, factura de servicios publicos, estado bancario, o carta del empleador); (2) prueba de cobertura minima esencial anterior (certificado de cobertura acreditable HIPAA, aviso de terminacion de Mercado o empleador anterior, o carta de terminacion de Medicaid del estado anterior); y (3) verificacion de ingresos (talones de pago recientes, carta del empleador, carta de desempleo, o Formulario 1040 del ano anterior). Los numeros de Seguro Social de todos los miembros del hogar que solicitan son requeridos.
